A stdio-to-WebSocket pipe for the Agent Client Protocol. ACP agents speak
      newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdin and stdout, so a client can normally only reach an
      agent it can spawn locally. `acp-bridge listen` runs where the agent lives, `acp-bridge
      connect` runs where the client lives and stands in for the agent, and the conversation
      between them is untouched.

      It forwards bytes rather than decoding them, so no protocol version, message shape, or
      future extension is something it can be wrong about.

A caching reverse proxy for the Git LFS HTTP API. Relays every Batch API call upstream so upstream remains the sole authority on access, rewrites the returned transfer URLs to point at itself, and serves object bytes from a local content-addressed store. A cache miss is fetched from upstream once and stored on the way through, so the next request for that object is local. Ships as a dotnet tool and as a container image for Kubernetes.
